journey: First-time skeptical Mexican clinic owner: landing, Alcance, expanded comparison, expanded FAQ ownership answer, contact consent, footer privacy check, all five contact steps with honest skeptical answers.
outcome: All five steps submitted; final declined screen reached. It says Elevator Web may not be appropriate and stores details to share resources. No accepted conversation, concrete follow-up, diagnosis alternative, or way to clarify the final answer is shown within the result card.

issues.title: No visible privacy information before saving name, WhatsApp and email
steps: Read Alcance and ownership FAQ before sharing details.
Open Hablemos and inspect the consent wording.
Look in page footer and navigation for privacy or data-handling information.
issues.expected: A visible way to review actual data-handling information or reach a privacy contact before choosing to save personal details.
issues.actual: The form explains that details are saved immediately and used to respond, but provides no privacy link. Navigation, footer, and expanded FAQ have no privacy item. The owner cannot inspect retention, deletion/contact, or other handling details through the visible UI before saving.

issues.title: Declined result changes the announced use of saved contact data
steps: At step 1 read consent allowing data use to respond to the request.
Submit all five steps with revenue undisclosed, exploration timing and No on final understanding question.
issues.expected: The final result describes data use consistently with the request consent, or offers an explicit choice before a different follow-up purpose.
issues.actual: Step 1 says data is used 'para responder a tu solicitud'. The declined result says 'Guardamos tus datos para compartirte recursos que puedan servirte.' It does not say whether resources will be sent, by which channel, or how to decline that follow-up.

issues.title: Final understanding question mixes patience with a best-option claim; skeptical answer ends without clarification
steps: Reach step 5 as clinic owner with Solo estoy explorando.
Read the final required Yes/No question.
Answer No because the owner has not established that this is their best option.
issues.expected: A clear, limited expectations question and a useful next step for an owner who needs clarification before deciding.
issues.actual: The question states the web 'atrae tráfico orgánico' and 'es tu mejor opción para escalar ... sin depender de anuncios' while asking ¿Lo entiendes?. A skeptical No ends in 'quizá no sea el paso más adecuado', only Volver al inicio, with no explanation of which answer caused the disposition and no clarification/contact or diagnosis alternative in the result. It is impossible to tell whether curiosity, misunderstanding, or disagreement with the best-option claim caused exclusion.

positiveFindings: Custom investment is explained clearly: scope and conditions are defined together before starting; step 5 repeats that it is discussed on the call. No fixed-price defect asserted.
